name: valorecon
description: ValoRecon — Your AI VALORANT coach & tactical companion

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "red,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:server && npm run test:cloud
scripts.build:all: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && npm run build:cloud && npm run build:web
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.release:verify: npm run test:all && npm run release:security-test && npm run release:clean-test
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "red,cyan" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix web"
